class.name: JRPGControlVariablesCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: changes one variable or a range of variables.
class.description: Applies [member operation] with an operand to variables [member first_id] to [member last_id]. The operand ([member operand_type]) is [member constant], variable [member operand_variable], a random number from [member random_min] to [member random_max] drawn for each variable (from the game's misc random stream), a value of the game ([member game_data] with [member data_id] and [member data_param]), or the formula [member script_text] ([JRPGFormula]). Integers stay integers, kept within [code]-2^62[/code] and [code]2^62[/code]; a variable holding a float works in floats; text counts as 0. Division rounds toward zero, and the remainder has the sign of the variable. Dividing by 0 leaves the variable as it is, with a warning, as does a range that is backwards or outside 1 to [constant JRPGGameState.MAX_VARIABLE_ID]. Authority: server.
